shortDescription: Configure local access settings on OpenManage Enterprise Modular.

options.name: ca_path
options.description: The Privacy Enhanced Mail (PEM) file that contains a CA certificate to be used for the validation.

options.name: chassis_power_button
options.description: The settings for the chassis power button.

options.name: device_id
options.description: The ID of the chassis for which the local access configuration to be updated. If the device ID is not specified, this module updates the local access settings for the I(hostname). I(device_id) is mutually exclusive with I(device_service_tag).

options.name: device_service_tag
options.description: The service tag of the chassis for which the local access settings needs to be updated. If the device service tag is not specified, this module updates the local access settings for the I(hostname). I(device_service_tag) is mutually exclusive with I(device_id).

options.name: enable_chassis_direct_access
options.description: Enables or disables the access to management consoles such as iDRAC and the management module of the device on the chassis.

options.name: enable_kvm_access
options.description: Enables or disables the keyboard, video, and mouse (KVM) interfaces.

options.name: hostname
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular IP address or hostname.

options.name: lcd
options.description: The settings for LCD. The I(lcd) options are ignored if the LCD hardware is not present in the chassis.

options.name: password
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular password. If the password is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_PASSWORD) is used. Example: export OME_PASSWORD=password

options.name: quick_sync
options.description: The settings for quick sync. The I(quick_sync) options are ignored if the quick sync hardware is not present.

options.name: timeout
options.description: The socket level timeout in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: OpenManage Enterprise Modular username. If the username is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_USERNAME) is used. Example: export OME_USERNAME=username

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), the SSL certificates will not be validated. Configure C(false) only on personally controlled sites where self-signed certificates are used. Prior to collection version C(5.0.0), the I(validate_certs) is C(false) by default.

options.name: x_auth_token
options.description: Authentication token. If the x_auth_token is not provided, then the environment variable E(OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN) is used. Example: export OME_X_AUTH_TOKEN=x_auth_token
